semantic_events.post_evidence: Corporate Professionals & Team-Oriented Individuals – Young professionals and workplace teams who use personality frameworks for collaboration, self-awareness, and productivity, valuing stylish and functional MBTI-inspired office accessories and team-building tools.
semantic_events.rationale: Same underlying subject matter (MBTI in the corporate/professional context) persists, but the organizing frame shifts. PRE frames it as a niche intersection ('MBTI under the corporate setting'); POST reframes it as a fully scoped audience segment with psychographic behaviors (collaboration, self-awareness, productivity) and product affinities (stylish/functional office accessories, team-building tools). PRE is generic-short and gets concretised — subsumption ('a fully scoped audience persona with attributes and product needs' is a specific way of being 'MBTI under the corporate setting') is plausibly TRUE under NARROW-ABSTRACT given PRE's brevity, so Narrowed is the strongest runner-up; however, PRE is not clearly a generic filler descriptor (it names a domain intersection), and the shift from 'niche intersection label' to 'audience persona with attributes/product affinities' is a frame change rather than pure scope-restriction, so Reframed is preferred. alternative_considered: Narrowed.
